name: Celeb no Koi Yuuwaku no Perfume
original_name: セレブの恋 誘惑のパフューム
source:
You work at a huge department store which stocks a huge variety of perfumes, when one day you come into contact with five high-class guys.
"I was in love with you before you even knew who I was."
Which celebrity will you fall in love with?
translation:
你在一家巨大的百货商店工作，里面有各种各样的香水，有一天你接触到了五个高级男士。
“在你还不知道我是谁之前，我就已经爱上你了。”
你会爱上哪位名人？
